Growth must read clearly: baby = cute infant (big head, large realistic eyes, stubby legs, fluffy, element only just starting), juvenile = gangly adolescent (features half grown), adult = majestic, fully developed. Same species and colors at every stage. Style: semi-realistic Roblox 3D render, low-poly faceted geometry with smooth shading, solid color regions, realistic eyes (never cartoon or anime), natural anatomy, soft even lighting, no text, no scenery. Reference: the creature's current adult design is on the LEFT; keep its species, identity, colors and signature features but craft it better. The creatures on the right only show the art style. CAPYBARON, a Secret ROYAL CAPYBARA made of faceted solid gold. Its royal regalia grows with it while it stays solid gold at every stage. Baby: a tiny round gold capybara pup with an oversized crown slipping down over its eyes. Juvenile: a chubby young gold capybara with a small crown and a short red cape. Adult: a fat, regal gold capybara king with a big jeweled crown, a long red royal cape with white ermine trim, and a small yuzu fruit balanced on its head.
